parsed.answer: The evidence supports the directional core of the claim: ATM-mediated phosphorylation downregulates PP2A, and in ATM deficiency (i.e., reduced PP2A phosphorylation) enhanced PP2A activity dephosphorylates HDAC4, driving its nuclear accumulation. However, no excerpt states that this occurs by enhancing a physical PP2A-HDAC4 interaction; the interaction mechanism is asserted in the claim but absent from the retrieved evidence. The claim is therefore only partially grounded and the proposed mechanism remains unverified.
